items.text: Minnesota (early week): Vikings traded a 2027 3rd for QB Kirk Cousins (from LV) at the Nov 10 deadline; he is expected to start at GB. QB Kyler Murray (Grade 2 hamstring) week-to-week. Monitor - WR Jauan Jennings (calf), S Theo Jackson (quad), both inactive Wk9. IR - G Donovan Jackson, TE Josh Oliver, C Nick Samac.
items.source: Heavy (Murray injury update after Cousins trade, Nov 10)

items.text: Green Bay (early week): OUT - RB Josh Jacobs (fractured finger, surgery; IR possible), G/C Sean Rhyan (high ankle, at least a month). Likely out - LB Zaire Franklin (hairline shin fracture), TE Josh Whyle (concussion), RB MarShawn Lloyd (knee). EDGE Micah Parsons (knee) only a 'smidgen' of optimism for Wk10. Monitor - CB Keisean Nixon (groin), LB Ty'Ron Hopper (chest). RB Chris Brooks has a good chance to return. Jordan Love starts.
items.source: Packers.com (Jacobs to miss time after finger surgery, Nov 9)
